description: This file declares the USBDevice class, which implements a plugin for USB device management within the WPEFramework. It includes nested Notification class for handling connection and device events, and defines interfaces for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: USBDevice
classes.description: Represents a USB device plugin that manages USB device events and interactions within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Handles notifications related to remote connection and USB device events, such as device plugged in/out and connection activation/deactivation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles the deactivation of a remote connection.
